theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U Z M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (K : Set (Eucl Q)), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → Z ⊆ U → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ Z) = 0 → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ Z) → (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ M ∩ (f ⁻¹' K ∩ Z), ‖L x‖ ≤ C) → ∃ h : Eucl P → ℝ, Integrable h ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), f x ∈ K → ‖θ x • nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)‖ ≤ h x
